chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: Of course, this data in the case of stock market is time series.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: And so it's arranged from oldest to newest vertically here.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: So we select the data we want to train on and then we iterate over this data over

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: time.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: So we evaluate the situation there and for a particular stock that gives us S,

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: our state, we consult our policy and that gives us an action.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: So we take that action, plug it into our system here, evaluate the next state.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: And we get our S prime and our reward.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: So, after one iteration here, we've got an S, an action, an S prime and an R or

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: an experience tuple.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: Once we get all the way through the training data, we test our policy and

chunks.title: Learning Procedure

chunks.text: So what do we mean by converge?

chunks.text: Well, each time we cycle through the data, training our Q table, and

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: then testing back across that same data, we get some performance.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: And we expect that each time we complete an iteration here,

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: our performance is going to get better and better.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: But after a point, it finally stops getting better and it converges.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: So overall, the chart's going to look something like this.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: Eventually, we reach this regime where more iterations doesn't make it better,

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
chunks.text: and we call it converged at that point.

chunks.title: Learning Procedure
